threads.body:
This can be removed.. ruffs up rule misses some stuff.

Other things that can be removed:

scripts/check_deps.py (lines 42–45):
  
diff
-try:
-    import tomllib
-except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Python < 3.11
-    import tomli as tomllib
+import tomllib


scripts/version_utils.py (lines 14–17):
  
diff
-try:
-    import tomllib
-except ModuleNotFoundError:
-    import tomli as tomllib
+import tomllib


2. Dead sys.version_info < (3, 11) Test Skip Markers in langchain

3. Stale pypy-3.10 Mapping and Comments

scripts/tox_matrix.py (lines 25, 30–31):
_PY_FACTOR_VERSION: dict[str, str] = {"pypy3": "pypy-3.10"} is dead code pointing to Python 3.10

4. random stuff

enum.StrEnum (Python 3.11+): Modality(str, Enum) (which manually defines def __str__(self) -> str: return self.value to work around Python 3.11's str(Enum) format change) and Role(str, Enum) in util/opentelemetry-util-genai/src/opentelemetry/util/genai/types.py (lines 162, 332) can use enum.StrEnum (verify against tox -e check-util-api / griffe first in case base-class change is flagged).

Branch Protection Rules:  if repository branch protection rules list specific 3.10 or 3.14 matrix job names as required status checks, they will need to be updated to the 3.11 / 3.15 job names (not sure if we do this)

replies.body: Done in b769550, and merged main. I left StrEnum out because check-util-api flags it; happy to do it in a separate PR.

